text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we're meeting in front of the
station
tomorrow at 9:00 a.m. Don't
forget.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Were you not listening to me? Or...
maybe I never
told you. Either way...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
With the help of an acquaintance, I've
been able
to acquire equipment and
chemicals for my
experiments at a low
cost.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My current experiment is at its most
crucial stage,
and I need the materials
right away.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So, listen. You're going to carry the
goods. You
need to be at the station by
9:00 a.m. Do not
forget.

It's 9:00 a.m. the following morning. I'm
waiting in
front of the station, but Agnes
Tachyon has yet
to arrive. An hour
passes, and then another.

Just as I begin to wonder if something
bad has
happened, I get a call from her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Behind... the academy... hurry... come...
Thud!

What's going on?! It sounds like she's
behind the
school building. I hurriedly
make my way back.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hey... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was conducting an experiment... and
then... I
started to lose consciousness...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was so absorbed in my work that I had
forgotten
to eat...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Protein, vitamins, sugar... nutrients...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm drifting off again... Trainer,
something,
some nutrition... please...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... hurry...

I grab the first thing that catches my eye
in the
cafeteria, pile it onto a plate, and
bring it back to
Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That hits the spot. My goodness,
that was a
close call.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It was worth the effort to hold out.
Thank you for
your timely response,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Still... Haha! What a mountain of food!
You must
have been worried sick!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah... Anyway, you saved me there.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to be more careful not to
forget to
eat in the future.

Agnes Tachyon pats her tummy and
smiles
contently, as if she's learned
something new.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hurry... please...

I rush to the school store and buy up a
bunch of
easy-to-eat foods to bring to
Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Phew! I'm revived!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Geez... See what happens when you let
me out of
your sight!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to be my assistant, you'll
need to
be more careful.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! Maybe I should develop an
emergency
call button just for you.

Despite her complaining about my
absence,
Agnes Tachyon smiles
contently, as if she's
learned something
new.
